column1: # Reference profiles for tools/language/find.py --like. One row per profile; a blank cell means "not known or not
# meaningful", and that feature is then left out of the distance. Counts are phonemes, PHOIBLE/WALS level (marginal loan
# phonemes left out); vowels count qualities (length is the long_vowels series). max_onset/max_coda are the language's own
# (find.py caps them at the engine's largest, 2). stress: initial|penult|final|weight|none (none = no stress accent: tone or
# pitch accent). word_order/adposition/case use the engine's typology values (case: none|few|many). synthesis is a judgement on
# the engine's 0-3 scale of complexity.mean_level (0 free words, 1 clitics, 2 affixes): isolating ~0.3, English ~0.8,
# agglutinating ~1.8-2.0. series: the series present, from find.SERIES. Final-vowel share, word length and the sound texture
# come from the profile's word list (reference_words.tsv; English uses tools/language/sketch.py ENGLISH_WORDS).
